description: Feature definitions and What If control metadata for demo cyber quote and bind probability models.

revenue_scale.label: Revenue Scale
revenue_scale.definition: Normalized annual revenue. Larger insureds can be more attractive to quote but may carry broader operational exposure.

records_exposure.label: Records Exposure
records_exposure.definition: Normalized count of customer, employee, patient, vendor, or other sensitive records exposed to cyber loss.

mfa_maturity.label: MFA Maturity
mfa_maturity.definition: Strength and coverage of multi-factor authentication across email, VPN, privileged access, and critical applications.

edr_coverage.label: EDR Coverage
edr_coverage.definition: Coverage of endpoint detection and response across servers, laptops, and other managed endpoints.

backup_resilience.label: Backup Resilience
backup_resilience.definition: Backup frequency, segmentation, and evidence of restore testing.

patch_discipline.label: Patch Discipline
patch_discipline.definition: Speed and consistency of applying critical security patches.

security_training.label: Security Training
security_training.definition: Security awareness cadence and phishing simulation maturity.

prior_claims.label: Prior Claims Signal
prior_claims.definition: Whether prior cyber claims, ransomware events, or loss-history concerns create an elevated claims signal.

vendor_dependency.label: Vendor Dependency
vendor_dependency.definition: Degree of operational reliance on third-party platforms, EDI providers, payment vendors, cloud providers, or other critical vendors.

limit_fit.label: Requested Limit Fit
limit_fit.definition: How closely the requested maximum cyber limit fits the insured's revenue scale.

industry_propensity.label: Industry Propensity
industry_propensity.definition: Industry-level baseline cyber risk based on the demo historical benchmark table.

risk_flag_load.label: Risk Flag Load
risk_flag_load.definition: Normalized count of underwriting risk flags listed for the submission.

operational_dependency.label: Operational Dependency
operational_dependency.definition: Degree to which the insured depends on operational technology, portals, EDI, payments, APIs, reservation systems, or similar critical systems.

claim_load.label: Historical Claim Load
claim_load.definition: Normalized incurred value from linked historical cyber claims.

open_claim_signal.label: Open Claim Signal
open_claim_signal.definition: Whether linked claim history contains open claims that may affect severity or authority review.

evidence_ratio.label: Evidence Confidence
evidence_ratio.definition: Share of required cyber evidence categories available in the submission.

broker_quality.label: Broker Data Quality
broker_quality.definition: Broker relationship data quality score from the broker database.

broker_response_quality.label: Broker Response Quality
broker_response_quality.definition: Normalized broker responsiveness based on average response hours.
